018
019public class DerelictContingent {
020        
021        public static float MAX_DMODS = 5;
022        //public static float MINUS_CR_PER_DMOD = 3f;
023        public static float MINUS_CR_PER_DMOD = 0f;
024        public static float MINUS_DP_PERCENT_PER_DMOD = 6f;
025        public static float EXTRA_DMODS = 4;
026        
027        public static float HULL_PERCENT_PER_DMOD = 10f;
028        public static float REPAIR_PERCENT_PER_DMOD = 10f;
029        public static float MINUS_CREW_PERCENT_PER_DMOD = 10f;
030        public static float MINUS_SALARY_PERCENT_PER_DMOD = 10f;
031        
032
033        
034        
035        public static class Level0 implements DescriptionSkillEffect {
036                public String getString() {
037                        return "\n*Maximum effect reached " +
038                                        "at " + (int) MAX_DMODS + " d-mods."
039                                        ;
040                }
041                public Color[] getHighlightColors() {
042                        Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
043                        h = Misc.getDarkHighlightColor();
044                        return new Color[] {h};
045                }
046                public String[] getHighlights() {
047                        return new String [] {"" + (int) MAX_DMODS};
048                }
049                public Color getTextColor() {
050                        return null;
051                }
052        }
053        
054        public static class Level1 extends BaseSkillEffectDescription implements ShipSkillEffect {
055                public void apply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id, float level) {
056                        FleetMemberAPI member = stats.getFleetMember();
057                        float dmods = 0;
058                        if (member != null) {
059                                dmods = DModManager.getNumDMods(member.getVariant());
060                                if (dmods > MAX_DMODS) dmods = MAX_DMODS;
061                        }
062                        
063                        if (dmods > 0) {
064                                float depBonus = dmods * MINUS_DP_PERCENT_PER_DMOD;
065                                //stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.DEPLOYMENT_POINTS_MOD).modifyPercent(id, -depBonus);
066                                stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.DEPLOYMENT_POINTS_MOD).modifyMult(id, 1f - (depBonus/100f));
067                        
068                                stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.DMOD_REDUCE_MAINTENANCE).modifyFlat(id, 1f);
069                                if (MINUS_CR_PER_DMOD > 0) {
070                                        float crPenalty = MINUS_CR_PER_DMOD * dmods;
071                                        stats.getMaxCombatReadiness().modifyFlat(id, -crPenalty * 0.01f, "Derelict Operations skill");
072                                }
073                                
074                                float hullBonus = dmods * HULL_PERCENT_PER_DMOD;
075                                stats.getHullBonus().modifyPercent(id, hullBonus);
076                                
077                                float repairBonus = dmods * REPAIR_PERCENT_PER_DMOD;
078                                float timeMult = 1f / ((100f + repairBonus) / 100f);
079                                stats.getCombatWeaponRepairTimeMult().modifyMult(id, timeMult);
080                                stats.getCombatEngineRepairTimeMult().modifyMult(id, timeMult);
081                                
082                                float crewMult = 1f - dmods * MINUS_CREW_PERCENT_PER_DMOD * 0.01f;
083                                stats.getMinCrewMod().modifyMult(id, crewMult);
084                                
085                                // happens automatically due to crew reduction
086//                              float salMult = 1f - dmods * MINUS_SALARY_PERCENT_PER_DMOD * 0.01f;
087//                              stats.getDynamic().getStat(Stats.SHIP_CREW_SALARY_MULT).modifyMult(id, salMult);
088                        }
089                        
090//                      if (EXTRA_DMODS > 0) {
091//                              stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.DMOD_ACQUIRE_PROB_MOD).modifyFlat(id, 1000f);
092//                      }
093                }
094                
095                public void unapply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id) {
096                        stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.DEPLOYMENT_POINTS_MOD).unmodify(id);
097                        stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.DMOD_REDUCE_MAINTENANCE).unmodify(id);
098                        //stats.getDynamic().getStat(Stats.SHIP_CREW_SALARY_MULT).unmodify(id);
099                        if (MINUS_CR_PER_DMOD > 0) {
100                                stats.getMaxCombatReadiness().unmodify(id);
101                        }
102                        
103                        stats.getHullBonus().unmodify(id);
104                        stats.getCombatWeaponRepairTimeMult().unmodify(id);
105                        stats.getCombatEngineRepairTimeMult().unmodify(id);
106                        stats.getMinCrewMod().unmodify(id);
107                        
108//                      if (EXTRA_DMODS > 0) {
109//                              stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.DMOD_ACQUIRE_PROB_MOD).unmodify(id);
110//                      }
111                }
112                
113                public void createCustomDescription(MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats, SkillSpecAPI skill, 
114                                TooltipMakerAPI info, float width) {
115                        init(stats, skill);
116
117                        info.addPara("Deployment point cost of ships reduced by %s per d-mod*", 0f, 
118                                                hc, hc, "" + (int)MINUS_DP_PERCENT_PER_DMOD + "%");
119                        
120                        info.addPara("Hull integrity increased by %s per d-mod*", 0f, 
121                                        hc, hc, "" + (int)HULL_PERCENT_PER_DMOD + "%");
122                        info.addPara("%s faster in-combat weapon and engine repairs per d-mod*", 0f, 
123                                        hc, hc, "" + (int)REPAIR_PERCENT_PER_DMOD + "%");
124                        //info.addPara("Crew required and crew salary reduced by %s per d-mod*", 0f, 
125                        info.addPara("Crew required reduced by %s per d-mod*", 0f, 
126                                        hc, hc, "" + (int)MINUS_CREW_PERCENT_PER_DMOD + "%");
127                        
128                        
129                        if (MINUS_CR_PER_DMOD > 0) {
130                                info.addPara("(D) hull deployment cost reduction also applies to maintenance cost,"
131                                                                + " but maximum CR is reduced by %s per d-mod*", 0f,
132                                                                hc, hc, "" + (int)MINUS_CR_PER_DMOD + "%");
133                        } else {
134                                info.addPara("(D) hull deployment cost reduction also applies to maintenance cost", hc, 0f);
135                        }
136                        
137                        info.addPara("Ships with d-mods gain new d-mods (up to 5), afterwards their d-mods periodically change", hc, 0f);
138
139                }
140        }
141        
142        public static class Level2 implements FleetStatsSkillEffect {
143                public void apply(MutableFleetStatsAPI stats, String id, float level) {
144                        stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.SHIP_DMOD_REDUCTION).modifyFlat(id, -EXTRA_DMODS);      
145                }
146                
147                public void unapply(MutableFleetStatsAPI stats, String id) {
148                        stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.SHIP_DMOD_REDUCTION).unmodify(id);
149                }
150                
151                public String getEffectDescription(float level) {
152                        //return "Recovered ships have " + (int) EXTRA_DMODS + " more d-mods on average";
153                        return "Recovered ships have more d-mods than normal";
154                }
155                
156                public String getEffectPerLevelDescription() {
157                        return null;
158                }
159                
160                public ScopeDescription getScopeDescription() {
161                        return ScopeDescription.FLEET;
162                }
163        }
164
165}
